cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The gallery says your portrait needs a stronger likeness. Let's take that as a practical note.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They didn't recognize you, did they?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Recognition depends on more than a face. Use the shirt I wore for the sitting as a reference; they need a clear identifying feature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I painted the shirt exactly. They asked why I'd put it on somebody else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the shirt is working. We'll bring the face into line with it. Start with the jaw; leave the part they recognized alone.

reason: Make A turn the harsh non-likeness assessment into supervised repair. B's evidence that the shirt already works redirects A's technical advice, preserving kindness without a separate comic prop.
